note: Two columns joined on each line. Left column: HIGH SCHOOL STAFF (Continued) (line 1) to line 39, then HIGH SCHOOL AIDES (heading line 40: Mathews, Sacksen, White), then MIDDLE SCHOOL STAFF (heading line 53: Carbone, Case). The RIGHT column from line 2 down to the end is the Middle School staff continuing (Ahlstrom ... Mercier): it carries no heading of its own at the top, but it holds replacements for Mrs. Case (art 6-8), Home Economics 6-8, Reading 6-8, Grade 8 and the Summer Program, and the next page prints MIDDLE SCHOOL STAFF (Continued); so right column is middle (printed 'Middle School'); this is my inference from content, not a printed heading at the top of the right column. Page school high from the left column. Headings share lines 40 and 53 with right-column entries. Position lines under names are ignored but role_raw carries them. Where a position is not printed (Ahlstrom, Cronin) role_raw says so. Sivula and Mercier appear here under Middle School and on p117 under High School. Garvey 'Part-time Administrative Assistant to Principal (3/5ths)' in the middle school, as on p115. Departures are inline remarks (Tanguay RESIGNED 12/17/80; Case RESIGNED 1/30/81). Honorifics: this page prints none (Sivula's 'High School) (B.9/77)' is his hire note). Line 63 page number. Integration pass, 31 Oct 2026: school bus contractors, drivers and volunteers moved from entries to ignored (not school staff; every 1971-1980 page treated alike), and `middle` written `turkey-hill` -- the 1972 and 1974 listings print the building as `Turkey Hill Middle School (Grades 5-7)`, the town's one middle school.
